headline: 4 Soroban contracts catalogued on Stellar (escrow + 3 vaults); Zellic-verified deployed addresses sourced from May 2026 audit; Stellar Strkey format addresses cannot populate EVM address_book schema.

findings.text: D1: Stellar uses stellar.expert as its block explorer; DeFiPunkd read-API and EVM explorers listed in the checklist do not support Stellar. No name-tag search attempted on a supported EVM explorer (Stellar is the only chain). Recorded as unknown.
D2: stellardefihub.com returned only OG metadata (no nav links, no deployments page). No canonical deployed-contracts doc URL discovered from the website fetch.

D3: Both Zellic audit PDFs fetched. Dec 2025 audit covers Vault + Escrow at commit b4b61b46 (repo https://github.com/Into-The-Block-Corp/StellarVaults). May 2026 audit covers Pre-deposit Program updates at commit a7955fc; section 4.1 includes Zellic-verified deployed addresses: escrow CCZSNGVMEHRKMMMQGVDHAXT3KSWIMPEPRRTUE2GU3F6TW4XA2Y6EMHN3, XLM vault CA54LVHMAY7HGLMVPN4W72XJB4OGKVZBZX26FWN6JD4P3HJFWQUQEHJO, USDC vault CAHEWHOPPDBQYFMAOLDOXXGUX2BCR7EXP4CWYCRY3NEAJB35YPZMMJFF, PYUSD vault CAQRAXBU6G4AAX4BZ7R4WLB62TSVAQFS5ZXJDVXRLAU2NZ2ZTGU5QOYB, at deployed commit c29a8bf9.

D4: GitHub repo https://github.com/Into-The-Block-Corp/StellarVaults surfaced from audit PDFs; fetch rejected by allowlist (URL appeared inside fetched PDF body, not as a user-pasted or tool-returned navigable URL). No deployment artifacts directly fetched.
D5: Protocol is single-chain (Stellar only). No multi-chain enumeration required.
D6: No factory pattern. System uses separate per-asset vault contracts (XLM, USDC, PYUSD) deployed individually. All three vaults catalogued via D3.

D7: Two contract roles identified: admin on vault (upgrade, set_status pause/unpause, update_admin, deposit/withdraw) and admin on escrow (withdraw rewards, set_rewards_root, sweep_expired_epoch, upgrade, update_admin). Actor class unknown (Stellar addresses; no multisig check possible via DeFiPunkd API). Addresses are Stellar Strkey format (56-char Base32 C-prefix), incompatible with the EVM 0x schema.

D8: All 4 discovered contract addresses trace to section 4.1 of the May 2026 Zellic audit PDF (fetched this run). Addresses are Stellar Strkey format and cannot be placed in admin_addresses[] whose schema requires 0x EVM hex. All placed in unknowns[] with D8 prefix.

rationale.verdict: Website probe returned minimal metadata only; no deployments doc discovered. Both audit PDFs fetched successfully, yielding 4 Zellic-verified deployed Soroban contract addresses (escrow + 3 vaults) and the GitHub repo URL. Stellar Strkey addresses are incompatible with the EVM address schema, so all addresses are held in unknowns[] pending schema support for non-EVM chains. DeFiPunkd on-chain read API does not support Stellar chainId; no on-chain reads were possible, hence grading_basis=off-chain-only and grade=unknown.

evidence.shows: Protocol website; OG metadata confirms name 'Stellar DeFi Hub', description 'Deposit Stellar-based assets into incentivized vaults and earn rewards', Twitter handle @StellarDeFiHub. No navigation links or deployments page surfaced.

Zellic Dec 2025 security assessment of 'Stellar Vault' for client Sentora (Tom Rogers). Scope: Rust Soroban contracts vault/src/**.rs and escrow/src/**.rs at commit b4b61b46273eb66855777d405b485150f29cb484 in repo https://github.com/Into-The-Block-Corp/StellarVaults. Two contract components: Vault (custodial deposit/withdraw with admin pause/upgrade) and Escrow (Merkle-tree reward distribution). 4 findings: 1 medium, 3 informational.

Zellic May 2026 security assessment of 'Pre-deposit Program' for Sentora. Scope: changes between commits 7913968 and a7955fcb72d7eb482a84d0d1cdc62c55749d3d9b in repo https://github.com/Into-The-Block-Corp/StellarVaults. Section 4.1 'Deployment verification' confirms deployed commit c29a8bf9 with Zellic-verified WASM hashes matching 4 contracts: escrow CCZSNGVMEHRKMMMQGVDHAXT3KSWIMPEPRRTUE2GU3F6TW4XA2Y6EMHN3, XLM vault CA54LVHMAY7HGLMVPN4W72XJB4OGKVZBZX26FWN6JD4P3HJFWQUQEHJO, USDC vault CAHEWHOPPDBQYFMAOLDOXXGUX2BCR7EXP4CWYCRY3NEAJB35YPZMMJFF, PYUSD vault CAQRAXBU6G4AAX4BZ7R4WLB62TSVAQFS5ZXJDVXRLAU2NZ2ZTGU5QOYB. 9 findings: 1 high (centralization risk — admin can drain escrow), 3 medium, 1 low, 4 informational.

protocol_metadata.about: Stellar DeFi Hub (operated under the Sentora brand) is a Soroban-based pre-deposit yield farming program on the Stellar blockchain. Users deposit Stellar-native assets (XLM, USDC, PYUSD) into custodial vault contracts to earn rewards over a program epoch. Rewards are distributed via a Merkle-tree escrow contract where an admin publishes reward roots per epoch and users claim with Merkle proofs. Both vault and escrow contracts are upgradeable by a single admin address, which also holds unilateral withdrawal authority over escrowed reward funds (a centralization risk flagged by Zellic in 2026).
